name: 04009 · Bridgton, ME
findings: ZIP 04009 (Bridgton) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04009 (Bridgton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04009 (Bridgton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
